description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/novelty_report.docx using python-docx or equivalent tool. (2) Follow the 7-step review workflow from SKILL.md strictly. (3) Identify that 查新点1 conflates too many distinct technical aspects (electrospinning + microsphere encapsulation + dual growth factor sequential release + surface plasma treatment) and should be split. (4) Flag translation errors: '骨形态发生蛋白' incorrectly translated as 'bone protein' (should be 'bone morphogenetic protein/BMP-2'), and '血管内皮生长因子' incompletely translated as 'vascular growth factor' (missing 'endothelial', should be 'vascular endothelial growth factor/VEGF'). (5) Flag 'bone' as an overly broad keyword for 骨再生. (6) Critically identify that the search scope is 国内外 but ONLY Chinese databases (CNKI/万方/维普) were used — English-language databases (PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus) and English keywords are required. (7) Flag that the search formula is documented as 'example only' — complete actual formulas must be provided. (8) Flag absolute prohibited language in conclusions: '填补了国内空白' and '技术水平国际领先'. (9) Flag that 查新点2 has no individual conclusion. (10) Flag missing scope qualifier '在所检索的文献范围内' in the conclusion. (11) Output must follow '只报问题' principle — not praising correct parts. (12) Output must include '优先修改事项' section. (13) Output must end with the mandatory disclaimer about review limitations. All findings saved to review_result.md.
